This attractive four-bedroom terraced house stands on a quiet street high above the river, within easy walking distance of the university, the hospital bus routes and the shops of the West End, and it has been carefully modernised by its owners without losing its Victorian character. The front door opens into a tiled vestibule and a broad hallway with a useful understair cupboard for coats, cases and bicycles. At the front of the house, the sitting room has a large bay window with views over the Tay to the Fife hills, together with deep skirtings, restored cornicing and a cast-iron fireplace with a gas stove. The dining kitchen runs across the back of the house, fitted with painted timber units, stone worktops, an electric range cooker, a dishwasher and a large fridge-freezer, and glazed doors lead out to the garden. A utility room and a downstairs cloakroom are close by. Upstairs, the main bedroom is a large double with fitted wardrobes and an en suite shower room, and the second and third bedrooms are both good doubles. The fourth bedroom is a comfortable single that would suit a home office equally well. A family bathroom with a freestanding bath and a separate shower completes the upper floor. The enclosed rear garden has a paved terrace, a lawn and a timber shed, and there is on-street parking outside. The house is let unfurnished, with gas central heating and double glazing throughout. Sorry, no smokers. Available now for a minimum term of twelve months, subject to references and a deposit equal to five weeks' rent.
